data.name: AlAmina
data.gender_notes: AlAmina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, AlAmina is the name of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) wife, Khadija bint Khuwaylid, who was his first wife and the first to believe in him. The name AlAmina symbolizes the protection and support she provided to the Prophet (pbuh) in the early days of his prophethood. The name AlAmina carries the meaning “The Protective One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlAmina usually hope their child will grow to embody the protective one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Provides emotional and spiritual protection to those around her.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlAmina total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
